snippet.title: The Night Shift - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The Night Shift is a first-person indie horror experience from RedSpiralStudios.

Step into a late-night shift where something feels off. The lights flicker, the silence is wrong, and you are no longer alone. Survive the night, uncover what is happening, and try to make it out before it’s too late.

Play or wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468610/The_Night_Shift/

This is the official launch trailer for The Night Shift.

Developed by RedSpiralStudios, The Night Shift focuses on atmospheric horror, tension-driven gameplay, and immersive first-person storytelling.

Follow The Night Shift on Social Media:
Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/redspiralstudio
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thenightshiftgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/redspiralstudio/
Website: https://www.thenightshiftgame.com/
